id: title:jurajmajerik:name the taken flag key when a clone collides with an ineligible flag

review.posthog_relevance: Adds runtime checks for feature flag compatibility and access control before experiment cloning, potentially preventing invalid or unauthorized experiment creation.
review.reason: The chunk explicitly adds checks for existing flags and access control, raising errors if incompatible or unauthorized. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the access control checks or helper functions, only the test assertions and removal of redundant service instantiation. The score relies on the observation of the check's addition, not its implementation or test results.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the access control checks or the helper functions used, only the test assertions and the removal of a now-redundant service instantiation. The score cannot be assigned without seeing the actual enforcement and helper implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for existing flags in the target team and raises a 400 error if the flag cannot support an experiment; also adds a 403 check for access control.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether a feature flag can be used for an experiment and whether the user has permission to use it, before cloning. This could prevent creating an experiment with an incompatible or unauthorized flag.
